plainText:
Lauren Kammerling is a voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Kammerling was born in Louisville, Kentucky, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the during , where she voiced Acerola. Kammerling is currently based in New York and affiliated with Ingrid French Management. In 2021, Kammerling married fellow Pokémon Voice Actor Jeremy Levy.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Acerola

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Bonnie (Damage Control) 
Belle (Princesses at the Bar Table)
